text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The year-end Arima Kinen. Yaeno Muteki was 
selected in 2nd place in the fan voting 
right behind Oguri Cap, earning her spot 
in the race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It makes total sense that Yaeno Muteki 
placed 2nd in the fan vote! Her strength 
and coolness from constantly fighting the 
Eternal Big Three are finally getting 
recognized, and that makes me happy too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Watching Ogurin's race made me a huge fan 
of Yaeno Muteki too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, though, Oguri Cap... 
She hasn't been looking so good lately. I 
wonder what's wrong...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, Oguri Cap has been in an 
uncharacteristic slump—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oguriin!! Go, go, go! Get 'eeeem!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah... Gh... haaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ogurin didn't quite have her usual 
sharpness today...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Is she feeling sick...? I wonder if she's 
eating properly...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Why, I wonder...? I don't know either. 
Even I don't...

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
If you're not feeling well, I want you to 
rest up... Seeing Ogurin run in pain... 
...is something I just don't want to 
see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, Oguri Cap was voted #1 in the 
fan poll for the Arima Kinen. Many fans 
are placing their hopes on her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Yaeno Muteki wants to run against 
the "Monster," Oguri Cap, too—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it is merely a greeting, I cannot 
afford to look disgraceful. I must 
straighten my collar and face it 
properly."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, as part of fan service, an event 
was scheduled at noon to introduce the 
participating Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here, the Arima Kinen runners will 
head onto the turf to each give a brief 
word about their determination.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Oguri-san. Looking forward to working 
with you today as well!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, yeah... Nice to meet you...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Miss Oguri, you were looking down, weren't 
you...
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's because my form has been 
slumping lately.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —However, if that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the Umamusume running in the 
Arima Kinen have appeared on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Mutekiii!! We're counting on you 
today too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Show us your full fighting spirit, Yaeno 
Muteki-i-i!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Show us a run that's true to who you are, 
Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oguriin!! We're rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the 2nd place fan-vote pick, 
this year's Autumn Tenno Sho winner, Yaeno 
Muteki!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ossu!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Yaeno Muteki!! You're already 
all fired up!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And backed by countless fans, 1st in the 
fan vote! Oguri Cap!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah! Ogriiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Oguri! Oguri!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: U... Ooooooooohhh!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Raaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Yaeno Muteki has taken off! She's in 
a full-on sprint!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chatter chatter chatter chatter!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki ran all the way to the fourth 
corner and... she's back! She came back!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Y-Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You've finally... lifted your head...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —You are—!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Miss Oguri, you are someone who absorbs 
the cheers of this massive crowd and turns 
it into strength!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That is your strength!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you keep looking down and closing 
yourself off, you'll never unleash your 
true power!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Did you really think that would be enough 
to defeat me?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Against me, Yaeno Muteki!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Do not shut yourself in, feel it!! The 
cheers of the crowd dedicated to you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Turn that into your strength and run!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —That is all!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ogurin! Do your best!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Oguri can win this!! She's definitely 
gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...The voices cheering for me. They fill 
my empty self with a surge of warm 
power...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—I'll show them! To answer every single 
cheer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap looked up at the stands and gave 
a strong wave, answering the cheers.
